meta.claim: Synthetic capability test. qrels are graph-derived, so this measures whether a coverage selector can execute the structural relation better than rank truncation, not human relevance. Constraints come from query metadata (type, symbols, module, chain), never from qrels; parsing them from raw question text is not implemented in this version.

gate.rule: CESR-code beats RRF(Porter,entity,graph) on all@10 at the same budget (delta>0, CI95 low>0) on at least one budget, OR matches all@10 (CI spans zero) with >=20% fewer tokens.
gate.verdict: exact constraints do rescue the evidence-set objective on code
